verdict.rationale: BugSnag's grouping docs say grouping shows which issues have the biggest impact on users, and a hands-on user confirms tracking how many users each bug affects. Session-level impact is only documented as a project-wide stability score, not as a per-issue count of affected sessions. Missing for 10: documented per-issue affected-user counts, per-issue affected-session counts, sorting or prioritizing the inbox by impact rather than event count, and recent independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, every issue quantifies real impact — how many users and sessions are affected — so I prioritize by blast radius, not raw event counts

citations.quote: BugSnag aims to group instances of the same event together to give you a clear view of which issues are having the biggest impact on your users
being able to track how many users are affected by a particular bug is amazing
Stability is a measure of the proportion of user application sessions that are error free.
